name: Pasquale Prostamo
evidence: Family tree only. Tree gives a death at PIZZO, 4 Jan 1829, and no source. CORROBORATED SIDEWAYS, NOT DOCUMENTED: at Domenico's wedding on 14 June 1849 the groom produced «la fede di morte del padre, E DELL'AVO PATERNO» — so the paternal grandfather was dead by 1849 and his death certificate existed. The tree independently puts that death at Pizzo, and the marriage act independently puts the family at Pizzo. Two things agreeing is not a source: the death act itself is in the Pizzo registers, unread. Status stays UNTESTED until it is opened.

name: Antonino Prostamo
evidence: NAMED IN HIS SON'S MARRIAGE ACT, 14 June 1849. Briatico Matrimoni 1849 atto 1 has Domenico «figlio di ANTONINO, di professione MARINARO, domiciliato DEFUNTO, e di MARIA FRAGALÀ, domiciliata al Pizzo». So Antonino was a sailor like his son, he was dead by June 1849, and his widow was living at Pizzo. The family tree's name for this generation — Antonino — is exactly right; it simply had no source until now. His own father's death certificate was produced at the same wedding («la fede di morte del padre, e dell'avo paterno»), which puts the third generation in the Pizzo records too.

name: Domenico Prostamo
evidence: HIS OWN MARRIAGE ACT, found 14 September 2026. Briatico Matrimoni 1849 atto 1, 14 June 1849: DOMENICO PROSTAMO, di anni TRENTASEI, NATO IN PIZZO, MARINARO, domiciled at Briatico, marries GIOVANNA VENTRICE, 21, born at Briatico, daughter of the late Giuseppe Ventrice, bracciale, and Caterina Cichello. TWO THINGS THE TREE HAD WRONG: he was born about 1813, not 1820; and he was not a Briatico man at all but a PIZZO man who married into Briatico. He was still «fu Domenico, marinaro» when his son Alfonso married in 1887, and Giovanna was alive and consenting in person in 1886.

name: Alfonso Prostamo
evidence: Aged 24 in January 1886 and 25 in May 1887, so born about 1862, not 1858 as the tree says. A MARINARO — a sailor, not a contadino. Married Caterina Melluso, 21, daughter of Leone Melluso, on 21 May 1887 at Briatico.
